meta.name: bolder
meta.description: Amplify safe or boring designs to make them more visually interesting and stimulating. Increases impact while maintaining usability.

copy.tagline: 让平淡的设计变得更有视觉冲击力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让设计更大胆、有趣又不失可用性
copy.tagline_en: Make safe designs bolder and more visually stimulating
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to amplify design impact while keeping usability

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的设计，找出过于安全或平淡的地方，然后通过放大字体、增强色彩、增加空间戏剧感等方式，让设计更有视觉冲击力和个性，同时保持可用性。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 让某个设计更大胆、更有视觉吸引力时触发。它会在执行前先收集目标受众、品牌调性等上下文信息。

say.text: 帮我把这个按钮设计得更大胆一些。
say.note: Claude 会分析当前按钮并给出放大、配色等建议。

say.text: 这个页面布局太普通了，让它更有冲击力。
say.note: Claude 会调整排版、色彩和空间，增加戏剧感。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes your design for safe or boring elements and amplifies them—using extreme typography, intensified colors, spatial drama, and visual effects—to increase visual impact and personality while maintaining usability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to make a design bolder or more visually interesting. It first gathers context like target audience and brand tone before proceeding.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest amplification.

say_en.text: This page layout is too plain, give it more impact.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust typography, color, and spacing for drama.
